filter.population: Diagnostic: every held-out training row of the fold. The Pass 2 obligations (shared contract: precision >= 0.30 and support >= 75 for the selected union, on the Pass 2 population, the remainder after Pass 1, at fit time) cannot be applied at their defined scope: no per-row Pass 1 route is tracked and rebuilding one needs a GLASS Pass 1 fit (PR 44). filter.support_scope: The rows and subscribers each variant keeps or removes are those of a standalone conjunction on held-out rows: requiring eci_warm drops the partner's other rows from that one rule. That is not the router-level coverage effect. In a router those rows can still be routed by other Pass 2 rules of the selected union, Pass 1 changes the population the rules see, and a precision gain can change which rules the union-aware selection admits, so router coverage can move by less, by more or in either direction. PR 44 measures it.

isolation.scope: The held-out label flips (Cell 42) are conditional on the fixed historical inputs: the frozen cut points, frozen_shares(), window_halfwidths() and _tail_range(). Flipping fold k's held-out labels leaves those constants as they are, so the flips show that no fit-side computation reads fold k's held-out labels; they cannot show, and do not claim, that the constants are independent of fold k's rows and labels. They are not. Fold k's engineer (the scoring values) is flipped in Cell 33.

limits: Random outer folds only. Under them period mix reproduces these bins' aggregate counts closely (Step 4A); a candidate's value under a chronological split is PR 49's question.

The filter is evaluated on a diagnostic population, every held-out training row, not on the Pass 2 population (the remainder after a GLASS Pass 1 fit, which no tracked artifact holds). One conjunction is screened against obligations defined for a selected union; GLASS checks them in sample at fit time, this step on held-out rows. Passing the screen is not compliance.

Every registered procedure reads full-training reference inputs: share_matched its targets (frozen_shares()), gap_placed its targets and windows (frozen_shares(), window_halfwidths()), tail_selected its first two targets and its tail range (frozen_shares(), _tail_range()). All come from FROZEN_SUPPORTS, the frozen bins' in-sample supports on all 32,950 training rows under the all-rows engineer, so each fold's held-out rows and labels helped form them. The frozen cuts have the same historical provenance. No arm of the comparison is fully nested.
The held-out label flips are conditional on those fixed inputs: they show that no fit-side computation reads a fold's held-out labels, not that the constants are independent of them.

The fold-local sensitivity (post-registration) replaces only gap_placed's shares and windows with fit-side ones; the frozen cuts it applies keep their historical provenance. It is outside the registration and the ranking.
Filter support figures are a standalone conjunction's; the router-level coverage effect is PR 44's.

Inner engineers are fitted on four fifths of a fit side (about 21,088 rows), the scoring engineer on all of it (26,360). tail_selected maps the chosen tail share onto the scoring values, where the tail can hold different states from those chosen.
The partner pool has `bin = 1` literals of up to two non-ECI bins. GLASS's rule space (`bin = 0` literals, beam search, the union-aware selection) is PR 44's.
Refit migration compares each fold's fit with the all-rows fit, which uses every training label; it measures stability, not accuracy.
Wilson intervals cover binomial sampling of the held-out rows with every fit fixed. Fold-to-fold variation is shown per fold; the fold and period removals overlap and are not independent.
Five candidate fits and five partner slots are judged. The criteria were fixed first, but a chance pass remains possible; PR 44's router comparison is the confirmatory step.
Every encoder uses labels of later contacts (Commit 3); this applies to all procedures alike. A past-only NSD or ECI is not built.

criteria.A0_feasible: a valid fit in all five folds (strictly increasing cuts; every bin holds a fit-side state)
criteria.A1_triggers: no PR 39 trigger (T1-T4) fires for the candidate's family on the held-out rows
criteria.A2_coverage: in every fold the focal bin's held-out support is >= 0.5 x the frozen focal bin's support in that fold
criteria.A3_ECI: eci_hot: (a) pooled lift >= 1.1 x the frozen bin's; (b) its smallest fold lift >= the frozen bin's
criteria.A3_NSD: nsd_elevated: (a) its smallest fold lift exceeds the frozen bin's; (b) its pooled lift is >= the frozen bin's pooled Wilson 95% lower lift bound; (c) its refit migration is <= the frozen bin's
criteria.A4_robust: with any one outer fold removed, and with any one contact period of at least 100 rows removed, the candidate's pooled focal lift stays >= the frozen bin's (eci_hot) or >= the frozen bin's pooled Wilson 95% lower lift bound (nsd_elevated), on the same remaining rows
criteria.filter_slot: a slot shows a filter effect in a direction (required or excluded) if that variant's pooled precision is >= 1.1 x the partner's, its precision exceeds the partner's in >= 4 folds (the slot needs >= 4 folds), and it passes the union screen pooled (support >= 75, precision >= 0.3)
criteria.filter_verdict: eci_warm advances to PR 44 as a filter in a direction if >= 3 of the 5 slots show the effect in that direction; otherwise it is closed out as a filter
criteria.ranking: advancing candidates of one family: NSD by smallest fold lift, ECI by pooled Wilson 95% lower lift bound; ties: the simpler procedure (share_matched, gap_placed, tail_selected)

handling.infeasible: an infeasible fold is recorded with its reason and nothing is substituted; the candidate fails A0 and its held-out tables are not formed
handling.lift_versus_support: tail_selected trades lift against support through the Wilson lower bound, within the registered share range. No candidate advances on lift bought with support below A2's floor, and a filter effect counts only if the variant passes the union screen

A filter variant with no held-out row in a fold has no precision there and counts as not exceeding the partner. A fold with fewer eligible partners evaluates those it has

known_before_registration.both: NSD and ECI are functions of the macro state (euribor3m, nr.employed, emp.var.rate): 346 states over 26 periods, so a cut moves whole states. NSD 0.192 / 0.23 and ECI 0.0291 / 0.0758 lie inside the value range some state takes across the six encoders.
known_before_registration.eci_hot: Pooled out-of-fold lift 2.501x (in sample 2.457x). In sample the bin is the 2,533 rows of periods at or above the base rate (3.48x) plus all rows of four May 2009 macro states (1,456 rows, 0.68x); all six training-side encoders place those four states above the frozen cut 0.0948.
known_before_registration.eci_warm: No drift in the bin: the quoted 1.49-1.67x were two historical deciles inside it; the historical whole bin was 0.92x. On the training rows the bin is 1.038x in sample and 1.031x out of fold, with rows from periods between 0.26x and 5.5x.

motivated.eci_warm_filter: eci_warm's whole-bin lift is about 1.03x; its value, if any, is as a condition on another rule. It keeps the frozen definition and is judged as a filter, not re-cut.
motivated.gap_placed: both families: cuts that land among closely spaced states let a small change between encoders move states across them. A cut placed in the widest gap between fit-side states near the frozen share leaves the most room.
motivated.share_matched: nsd_elevated: fold 0's encoder shifted whole states across fixed cuts. If the shift is a change of scale, cuts placed at the frozen bins' row shares of each fold engineer's own values restore the membership.
motivated.tail_selected: eci_hot: every encoder places four low-rate May 2009 states above the frozen cut, so no label-free re-placement of the frozen structure can remove them. A label-using choice of the upper tail, made on the fit side, can try, at a cost in support.

known_before_registration.not_computed_before_registration: No candidate cut, partner rule, filter variant or held-out statistic of one had been computed when this registration was fixed. Its design used the Step 4A findings above, the PR 39 record's in-sample bin supports, and the frozen GLASS profile and shared contract.
known_before_registration.nsd_elevated: Pooled out-of-fold lift 2.486x, folds 0.62-3.36x. Fold 0's encoder moved whole macro states across both cuts (seven May 2009 states into the bin, the 50 in-sample states into nsd_hot); all 653 rows entering or leaving the bin between the in-sample and out-of-fold encoders are fold-0 rows.

gap_placed.rule: cut j at the widest value gap among boundaries whose fit-row share below lies within q_j +/- h_j, h_j = 0.25 x the smaller frozen share of the two bins the cut separates (each bin keeps at least half its share outside both windows). An empty window falls back to share_matched's boundary
gap_placed.uses_labels: no (beyond the fold engineer's own fit)

share_matched.rule: cut j at the block boundary whose fit-row share below is nearest q_j, the frozen bins' cumulative in-sample row share
share_matched.uses_labels: no (beyond the fold engineer's own fit)

tail_selected.rule: cuts 1-2 as share_matched. On the selection values, among block boundaries whose upper tail holds a fit-row share in [0.060531, 0.242124] (0.5 to 2.0 x the frozen eci_hot share; a smaller tail could not meet A2), choose the tail with the largest Wilson 95% lower bound of its fit-side subscriber rate (ties: more rows, then the lower boundary). Cut 3 is the scoring-value boundary above cut 2 whose tail share is nearest the chosen share (ties: the larger tail)
tail_selected.uses_labels: yes, fit side only, on selection values
tail_selected.why_ECI_only: Step 4A ties NSD's instability to an encoder moving whole states, which the label-free placements address; a label-using search there would add selection variance without targeting that cause

content.states_and_ties: fit-side states whose values differ by at most 1e-12 form one block. Cuts lie only between blocks, at the midpoint of the two neighbouring values, so a cut never splits a macro state on the fit side and never equals a fit-side value. A held-out value equal to a cut goes to the lower bin ((lo, hi] intervals). Equal distances to a target share: the lower boundary. Equal gaps: the boundary nearest the target share, then the lower one

values.selection: inner cross-fitted values: each fit row valued by an inner engineer that never saw its label. A state's selection value is the mean over its fit rows. Every label-using choice (tail_selected's tail; partner rules and their warm variants, binned with the frozen cuts) uses these
